editing.still_format: Current screenshots: lossless WebP. Native images crop OS bars and reduce proportionally; HOST preserves original pixels. Decoded RGBA checked against PNG reference for all 64.

historical_origin: Seven silent MP4 exports retained byte for byte from the September 2026 showcase; six from owner-supplied Android recordings prepared September 22, plus the earlier September 17 1HITKO export. Exact app builds unverified.
